same_loaded_preference.decision: Preferred and structurally compatible: workload_runtime already creates a new backend/target per request over one resident model/head, then releases request state symmetrically. rules: One loaded target+head per category, both S/O gated before any warmup or measured request; same process IDs and source manifest through category.
Fresh native target cache, MTP head KV cache, nonce, channel/chunk queues per request; no prompt prefix reuse.

Short queue warmup prompt exact original bytes, cap32, one per mode/process; two measured repeats per mode/case. Keep first long-shape request measured; no silent extra shape warmups. Gate-induced warming disclosed symmetrically.

Backend construction excluded in both timers as existing convention; no prefill/async work may start there. Timed interval begins before reset/prefill and ends after finish ACK, drain and synchronization.

fallback_bracket.trigger: Only if same-loaded mode switching is shown incompatible during admission; choose and freeze fallback before measured collection, not after seeing ratios.
fallback_bracket.design: Per original category run serial-before -> overlap -> serial-after with identical executed source and only explicit mode selection differing; each process has its own exact cap32 warmup plus two repeats for each of three cases. Preserve original per-mode context order/repeats within each filtered schedule.
fallback_bracket.estimator: For each case/repeat/metric, ratio=O / ((S_before+S_after)/2), then arithmetic median of its two ratios. Retain and report ratios against before and after separately, drift and gate/warm differences. Never select minimum/best/most favorable reference.
fallback_bracket.disclosure: Separate-load bracket is not same-loaded randomized pairing and is NOT an 84-request execution. It needs a separately frozen expected set and cannot reuse 84 coverage claim.

predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.same_loaded: For metric X in {first_token_seconds,wall_seconds}, r[c,j]=X_overlap[c,j]/X_serial[c,j] for sample repeat j in {0,1}; R[c]=arithmetic median of these two ratios; reduction[c]=1-R[c]. Do NOT use ratio of medians, inverse throughput-ratio median, pooled token rates or archived fastest sample.
predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.long_gate: EACH exact long ID must have R_TTFT <= 0.70 AND R_wall <= 0.85, unrounded. Any one long case failing either threshold means target_not_met. Threshold equality passes. Report both repeats/ranges and all 18 per-case regressions; equal-case aggregates descriptive only.
predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.correctness: Both ranks and all methods/repeats match exact archived greedy token_ids and finish_reason for all 18 original cases; any deviation fails correctness even if current S/O agree. Preserve fresh-cache and admitted exact arithmetic configuration.
predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.stop: Respect official EOS IDs [248044,248046], include EOS as an output event, reject EOS before last, stop iff last is EOS; length iff no EOS and actual N equals original cap. Accept original length-capped completions as complete requests at their frozen caps, not naturally finished answers. No forcing/padding/early truncation or shorter cap.
predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.completeness: Any missing/duplicate/extra request, failed/truncated run, unknown cleanup, unbound source/mode, absent cache part or absent action stream -> INVALID/INCOMPLETE, never performance pass. Retain attempted failures and expected missing IDs, no survivor-only acceptance or time imputation. Legitimate slow valid rows remain in estimator.
predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.pressure: Sole parent hardware owner collects both host preflight and request-boundary/in-run pressure/swap/disk records. Pressure must be exactly1 on both throughout accepted attempt (finite predeclared sampling). Missing health, any pressure2/other, insufficient8GiB reserve, route ambiguity, competing workers or unproven cleanup blocks/stops trial and invalidates acceptance. No unrelated process termination. Current laptop pressure2 supplied by parent blocks GPU trials; not independently measured here.
predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.inflight: Exactly declared max2 chunks, no unbounded buffering. Timeout, missing credit/ACK, stale chunk, leak or queue not drained at finish/reset is failure; do not silently fall back to serial.
predeclared_estimator_and_verdict.statistics: Two repeats are descriptive and cannot support tail-latency, confidence-interval or general-workload guarantees. Passing means this exact frozen suite under recorded conditions only.

Equal rank action counts with wrong verify current token, wrong accepted/rejected progression, forged counters, replacement of one chunk by another of identical token count, swapped chunk identities and changed shifted tokens must all fail.
Delete all actions on both ranks while retaining success/count flags and output tokens: fail. Remove individual snapshot/verify/commit/final forward/finish or stage evaluation: fail.

Keep both ranks in same wrong mode or change startup/result/event/schedule mode separately: fail against externally pinned per-request manifest; verifier numerical mode and prefill scheduling mode are distinct.

For every target KV keys/values/offset, recurrent convolution and recurrence arrays, plus draft-head keys/values/offset: delete/duplicate/replace one part with another while preserving count; fail at each chunk/final/continuation and native256 gate. Forge shape/dtype/offset/finite/tolerance metrics under strict_pass=true: fail.

Carry chunk from request A into B with unchanged bytes or reused nonce/cache epoch; mutate nonce/ordinal/mode/sequence/start/end; fail. Also reuse whole A stream and rewrite superficial IDs: independent expected prompt offsets/cache epoch/nonce uniqueness must catch it.

Delayed old-request ACK, duplicated or reordered chunk, missing/extra credit, max_inflight exceeded, premature reset/finish/decode before drain, leftover head/target cache, unsupported op alias or silent serial fallback: fail.

Missing/failed/extra/duplicate run, bool-as-int, duplicate JSON keys, NaN/Inf/overflow timing, wall<TTFT, EOS in middle or wrong stop/cap, pressure missing/non1, failed cleanup, source helper omission or receipt+source hash co-forgery: fail.
